headline: Last session: Indian benchmarks post longest weekly losing run in 25 years amid persistent FII selling.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Persistent and heavy selling by Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs)
Global risks including rising oil prices and interest rate hike concerns
Outflows driven by global economic uncertainty and rate hike fears
Anticipation and caution surrounding the upcoming Q2 earnings season
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty posted their longest weekly losing run in 25 years
The Indian market recorded its worst monthly performance since March
Jio Platforms is reportedly planning a $3.8 billion IPO for late October
Fourteen midcap stocks have declined for five consecutive trading sessions
summary: Indian benchmarks recorded an eighth consecutive week of losses, marking the longest weekly losing streak in 25 years. Heavy FII selling and global macro pressures resulted in the market's worst monthly performance since March. Investors are now focusing on upcoming Q2 earnings dates for major IT firms and the potential Jio Platforms IPO.
